extraction.Name: Robert Brewer
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want his patent in fee to his 160 acre allotment at the time it was issued, April 13,1918,as he did not want to pay the taxes;but he was informed that it would be taxed, and sold for same,if he did not accept the patent, and pay his taxes, so he took the patent
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: sold his quarter of land to E.L. Ulrich, of Kadoka, South Dakota, for $1000.00, $500.00 in cash and $500.00 in trade
extraction.Buyer: E.L. Ulrich, of Kadoka, South Dakota, for $1000.00, $500.00 in cash and $500.00 in trade
extraction.Occupation/Income: clerks in a store at Manderson, South Dakota; and that this is his only source of income
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent; health is good; has a wife and 8 children to support; considers he received a very poor price for his land; never sold his land for any debts incurred prior to receiving his patent in fee; has never received any help from the County nor the United States Government; document sworn March 5, 1929
